title: FraudFeatureVector
description: Engineered real-time features for SageMaker fraud and anomaly inference

transaction_amount.description: Nominal transaction amount in local currency

avg_amount_24h.description: Rolling average transaction amount over the preceding 24 hours

transaction_count_5m.description: Number of transactions observed in the last 5 minutes

transaction_count_1h.description: Number of transactions observed in the last 1 hour

amount_deviation.description: Ratio of current transaction amount to customer historical mean

new_device.description: True if device_id has not been seen for this account in the last 90 days

location_change.description: True if geographic distance indicates impossible travel velocity

international_flag.description: True if transaction country is different from customer account base country

merchant_risk.description: Historical fraud incidence rate for the merchant category

account_age_days.description: Tenure of the customer bank account in days
